titulo: Cella stays until the door closes
caption:
Cella stays until the door closes

Cella stayed at the door until the other one was gone.

People remember a visit mostly by how it ended, so the last few seconds count for more than their length suggests.

Send it to the friend who waves from the window until you turn the corner.

#Cella #habits

alt: A short film with no voice and no text, with music. An entryway with a door on the right. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one next to it, pulse a happy goodbye. The door opens and warm light shows. They walk to the door together, the blue one looks back with happy eyes, then walks out of the frame. The black one keeps watching the open door, walks over and eases it shut, and its eyes turn happy with a small pulse.
